verdict.rationale: The evidence mentions Bitbucket Server and Data Center only as sources to migrate away from toward Bitbucket Cloud. Nothing documents running a self-hosted instance on low-resource hardware or support for multiple operating systems, CPU architectures, or database backends. Private CI runners are a different capability (pipeline execution, not a self-hosted Bitbucket instance) and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can run a self-hosted instance on low-resource hardware across multiple OSes, CPU architectures, and database backends
